mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM tb_selling_price s INNER JOIN ( SELECT fuel_type, MAX(effective_from) AS max_date FROM tb_selling_price GROUP BY fuel_type ) latest ON s.fuel_type = latest.fuel_type AND s.effective_from = latest.max_date ORDER BY s.fuel_type
SELECT * FROM tb_selling_price WHERE fuel_type = #{fuelType} ORDER BY effective_from DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_selling_price (fuel_type, selling_price, effective_from) VALUES (#{fuelType}, #{sellingPrice}, #{effectiveFrom}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE selling_price = VALUES(selling_price)
